The river bank has become an important part of daily life. The camping site looked quieter than usual that evening. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. For example, the house sits on top of a hill.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Lily bought a sweater online because it was much cheaper. Ericaceous compost suits camellias.

There are always more possibilities than we expect. At first, Lily found it difficult to keep the habit. Lily keeps a small cat at home and feeds it every morning. In fact, patches of fog cling to the valley floor.

The experience taught Lily more than any book could. Lily believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. People around Lily often share different ideas about the camping site. Best of all, a hedgehog curled up in the leaves.
Lily ordered dumplings and tea at the river bank last night. Lily wrote down every idea in a small notebook. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right.
